answer: Beacon decay bond stops fakes: each locks 120 credits in the harbor registry. Each epoch a beacon on the reef flashes a challenge; a key-signed answer costs 45. The ridge ledger records each answer; a miss decays the bond by 15, below 60 rewards freeze. Rented answers fail: each challenge binds the holder's key history. 1,000 fakes cost 45,000 per epoch against a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 5,000. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its bond.
